metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Suspicious Rundll32 Execution With Image Extension
properties.description:
Detects suspicious rundll32 eecution using files with image extensions
This was observed in DFIR reports, the files are not really images.
properties.query:
// Detects suspicious rundll32 eecution using files with image extensions
// This was observed in DFIR reports, the files are not really images.
let cmd_any = dynamic([".bmp",".cr2",".eps",".gif",".ico",".jpeg",".jpg",".nef",".orf",".png",".raw",".sr2",".tiff",".tif"]);
_Im_ProcessCreate(commandline_has_any=cmd_any,targetprocess_has_any="rundll32.exe")
| where CommandLine !has ".dll"
| extend
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
    AccountDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUserDomain", "")),
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DvcHostname", "")),
    ProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("TargetProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("CommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(ProcessName)
